label: Succeeded Frankfurt School first generation, rebuilding rationality via communicative action
description: Jürgen Habermas adopted Theodor W. Adorno's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Theodor W. Adorno's perspective to Jürgen Habermas's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
